turns.replyText:

- **US orders:** You can use a **prepaid return label** in the [Returns Portal](https://returns.fashionnova.com/fashionnova/returns).
- **Canada orders:** An **EPG prepaid label** is available for **$9.99 USD** (charged separately).
- **All other international orders:** There’s **no prepaid label**, so you choose the carrier and pay return shipping.
